name: Tough Monkey 56
author: DawidMazurek4
description: Neon pill yellow toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #000000 to #000000, transform becomes translateX(1.5em), left becomes 80%. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #000000.
